The '''''Bellicose''''' was an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]], commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Aban]], that joined [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] fleet during Thrawn's campaign against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]. It was made [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] at the time of an operation in the [[Taanab system/Legends|Taanab system]], during which the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Joruus C'baoth]] did as he pleased with the ''Bellicose''{{'s}} gunnery controls despite Aban's orders. Later, the ship participated in an [[Battle of Ando (Thrawn campaign)|assault]] operation against the New Republic base of [[Ord Pardron/Legends|Ord Pardron]] as part of Thrawn's plan to [[Battle at Ukio|capture]] the [[Ukio system/Legends|Ukio system]]. The ''Bellicose'' last appeared at the [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|Battle of Bilbringi]].

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
A Rebel training mission in the ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]'' game depicts Calamari Cruiser [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']] being trapped by [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor]] ''[[Restrainer]]'' and subsequently attacked by ISD ''Bellicose'' and VSD [[Jundland (Victory-class)|''Jundland'']]. Rebel fighters have to destroy the ''Restrainer'' in order for the ''Liberty'' to escape. It is unknown, however, whether this fictional scenario recreates an actual battle between said forces, or when and where it would have taken place.
